'''Hudson Williams''' (born February 13, 2001) is a Canadian actor. He rose to prominence for his breakout role as [[Shane Hollander]] in the [[Crave (streaming service)|Crave]] original television series ''[[Heated Rivalry]]'' (2025–present), for which he won the [[Canadian Screen Award for Best Leading Performance in a Drama Series]].<ref name="CBC-CSA">{{cite news |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/entertainment/2026-canadian-screen-awards-9.7218635 |title=Heated Rivalry dominates 2026 Canadian Screen Awards |first=Kayla |last=McLean |work=[[CBC News]] |date=May 31, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> He will appear in the upcoming Crave series ''[[Yaga (TV series)|Yaga]],'' the Netflix limited series ''The Altruists,'' and the films ''Apparatus'' and ''[[Tyrant (film)|Tyrant]]''.<ref name="Yaga" /><ref name="Altruists" /><ref name="Apparatus" /><ref name="Tyrant" />

== Early life and education ==
Williams was born on February 13, 2001, in [[Kelowna]], British Columbia, and moved as a young child to [[Kamloops]], British Columbia, where he was raised.<ref name="ShutUpEvan1">{{cite AV media |people=Katz, Evan Ross (host); Williams, Hudson (guest) |date=January 20, 2026 |title=Hudson Williams Part 1 (Full Episode) |series=Shut Up Evan |medium=Podcast |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sVP2v04K7K8 |time=33:19 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="CMF">{{cite web |url=https://cmf-fmc.ca/now-next/articles/they-shoot-they-score/ |title=They Shoot, They Score |first=Ingrid |last=Randoja |work=Canada Media Fund |date=November 20, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="VanSun">{{cite news |url=https://vancouversun.com/entertainment/heated-rivalry-star-hudson-williams-donates-money-to-b-c-childrens-hospital-at-golden-globes |title=Heated Rivalry star Hudson Williams donates money to B.C. Children's Hospital at Golden Globes |first=Dana |last=Gee |work=[[Vancouver Sun]] |date=January 12, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> His mother, an interior designer, is Korean, and his father, a mechanical engineer, is of British and Dutch descent.<ref name="GQ-Hype">{{cite magazine |url=https://www.gq.com/story/heated-rivalry-gq-hype |title=The Naked Ambition of the Heated Rivalry Boys |first=Mickey |last=Rapkin |magazine=[[GQ]] |date=December 23, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="HL">{{cite web |url=https://hollywoodlife.com/feature/who-is-hudson-williams-heated-rivalry-5490972/ |title=Who Is Hudson Williams? 5 Things to Know About the 'Heated Rivalry' Star |first=Elisabeth |last=McGowan |work=Hollywood Life |date=December 1, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> 

Williams began his schooling at a [[French immersion]] kindergarten before transferring, at his mother's suggestion, to Beattie School of the Arts, where he studied dance, music and theatre.<ref name="ShutUpEvan1" /> He later graduated from [[Sa-Hali Secondary School]] in Kamloops, where he played on the basketball team and trained in [[mixed martial arts]].<ref name="MuchMusic">{{cite AV media |title=The Cast of 'Heated Rivalry' Plays "Most Likely To" {{!}} Connor Storrie & Hudson Williams |publisher=[[MuchMusic]] |date=November 28, 2025 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZWA7OBtUppg |via=YouTube |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="PRP">{{cite AV media |title=The Permanent Rain Press Interview with Hudson Williams {{!}} Heated Rivalry – Shane Hollander |publisher=The Permanent Rain Press |date=November 29, 2025 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pKpeGdbkzXw |time=14:47 |via=YouTube |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> He renewed his focus on acting in grade 11, and has said that taking acting classes in [[Vancouver]] persuaded him that acting could become a viable profession.<ref name="ShutUpEvan1" />

In 2020, Williams moved to Vancouver to attend [[Langara College]], where he earned an acting certificate from the Film Arts program that same year.<ref name="PRP" /><ref name="USAToday">{{cite news |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/entertainment/tv/2026/02/04/inside-hudson-williams-life-before-heated-rivalry/88401848007/ |title=Hudson Williams' life before 'Heated Rivalry,' according to his friends |first=Greta |last=Cross |work=[[USA Today]] |date=February 4, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> After graduating, he began writing and directing short films and attending acting auditions while working as a [[restaurant server]] in [[New Westminster]].<ref name="THR-interview">{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-features/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-interview-1236449733/ |title='Heated Rivalry' Star Hudson Williams on Shane and Overnight Success |first=Nicole |last=Fell |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=December 16, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="CTV">{{cite news |url=https://www.ctvnews.ca/vancouver/article/didnt-expect-it-to-get-this-big-hudson-williams-old-spaghetti-factory-colleagues-blown-away-by-his-rise-to-fame/ |title='Didn't expect it to get this big': Hudson Williams' Old Spaghetti Factory colleagues blown away by his rise to fame |work=CTV News Vancouver |date=January 21, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> His first short film as writer and director was ''Snow Angel''.<ref name="PRP" />

== Career ==
=== Early work (2020–2024) ===
Williams built his early career through self-produced short films made with a recurring group of Vancouver-based collaborators and the films attracted significant rise in viewership following his rise to fame.<ref name="USAToday" /> He received the Best Ensemble award at the 2024 Vancouver Badass Film Festival for the short film ''Devil Makes Three'', and won Best First-Time Director at the 2026 Hollywood ShortsFest for his short film ''Rancid''.<ref name="VBFF">{{cite web |url=https://www.imdb.com/event/ev0004471/2024/1/? |title=Vancouver Badass Film Festival (2024) |website=[[IMDb]] |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="ShortsFest">{{cite web |url=https://hollywoodshortsfest.com/winners/ |title=Winners 2026 |publisher=Hollywood ShortsFest |year=2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>

His early screen credits include the episode "IRL" of the CBC drama ''[[Allegiance (Canadian TV series)|Allegiance]]'' (2024), the television films ''Nobody Dumps My Daughter'' and ''All I Need for Christmas'', and the episode "The Disciple" of the CBS series ''[[Tracker (American TV series)|Tracker]]'' (2025).<ref name="HL" /><ref name="Yahoo-Tracker">{{cite web |url=https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/tv/articles/hudson-williams-tracker-playing-shane-111639949.html |title=Hudson Williams Was on 'Tracker' Before Playing Shane Hollander on HBO's Steamy 'Heated Rivalry': What to Know |work=Yahoo Entertainment |date=December 3, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>

=== ''Heated Rivalry'' and breakthrough (2025–present) ===
In 2025, Williams was cast as [[Shane Hollander]] in the sports romance television series ''[[Heated Rivalry]]'', created and directed by [[Jacob Tierney]] and based on the ''Game Changers'' novel series by [[Rachel Reid (author)|Rachel Reid]].<ref name="TeenVogue">{{cite magazine |url=https://www.teenvogue.com/story/inside-heated-rivalry-the-gay-hockey-romance-series-changing-queer-tv-exclusive |title=Inside "Heated Rivalry," the Gay Hockey Romance Series Changing Queer TV |first=Max |last=Gao |magazine=[[Teen Vogue]] |date=November 20, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="THR-review">{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-reviews/heated-rivalry-review-hbo-max-gay-hockey-drama-1236435495/ |title='Heated Rivalry' Review: HBO Max's Horny Hockey Drama Is a Playful Gay Romance for Grown-Ups |first=Daniel |last=Fienberg |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=November 26, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> His audition process included a self-tape, a callback with Tierney, and three chemistry reads; his chemistry with co-lead [[Connor Storrie]] was an important factor in Tierney's casting decision.<ref name="PRP" /><ref name="Out">{{cite web |url=https://www.out.com/gay-tv-shows/heated-rivalry-connor-storrie-hudson-williams-interview |title=Heated Rivalry: Hudson thought Connor would 'pin me down' |first=Bernardo |last=Sim |work=[[Out (magazine)|Out]] |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="EW">{{cite web |url=https://ew.com/heated-rivalry-creator-discusses-question-about-lead-actors-sexuality-11859893 |title='Heated Rivalry' creator doesn't see 'any reason' to confirm the sexuality of lead actors |first=Ryan |last=Coleman |work=[[Entertainment Weekly]] |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="Variety-chem">{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/heated-rivalry-actors-sexual-chemistry-auditions-1236596271/ |title='Heated Rivalry' Actors Say Sexual Chemistry Started in Auditions |first=Michaela |last=Zee |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=December 1, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>  Williams has said that his mother had previously voiced concern that he would have trouble getting acting roles as an [[Asian Canadian]], his mixed heritage proved to be a crucial feature for his casting as Shane Hollander.<ref name="PRP" /> Williams modeled aspects of the character on athletes such as [[Sidney Crosby]], [[Connor McDavid]], [[Kobe Bryant]] and [[Tom Brady]].<ref name="PRP" />

''Heated Rivalry'' premiered on Crave on November 28, 2025, and became a global success after [[HBO Max]] began streaming it in the United States.<ref name="CapitalFM">{{cite web |url=https://www.capitalfm.com/news/tv-film/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-age-how-old-height-shane/ |title=Heated Rivalry actor Hudson Williams' age, height, past roles, where he's from and more |first=Sam |last=Prance |work=[[Capital (radio network)|Capital FM]] |date=December 1, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="PinkNews">{{cite web |url=https://www.thepinknews.com/2026/07/23/first-look-at-hudson-williams-in-new-witchy-thriller-yaga/ |title=First look at Hudson Williams in new witchy thriller 'Yaga' |work=[[PinkNews]] |date=July 23, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> Williams received praise for the subtlety of his acting and his ability to convey Hollander's inner thoughts, as well as his nuanced and non-stereotypical portrayal of an [[autistic]] character.<ref name="Time">{{cite magazine |url=https://time.com/7344379/heated-rivalry-autism-shane/ |title=Heated Rivalry Handles Autism With Love, Care, and a Touch of Awkwardness |first=Sarah |last=Kurchak |magazine=[[Time (magazine)|Time]] |date=January 9, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> Reid commented that Williams fully embodied the role, praising the expressiveness of his face.<ref name="Today">{{cite web |url=https://www.today.com/popculture/tv/rachel-reid-heated-rivalry-show-interview-rcna247427 |title=Exclusive: 'Heated Rivalry' Is Steamy Sensation. Author Rachel Reid Hopes It Changes TV Romance for Good |work=[[Today (American TV program)|Today]] |date=December 7, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> ''[[/Film]]'' singled out Williams and Storrie for their [[microexpression]] work, and the chemistry between the two leads has received extensive praise, with Kaiya Shunyata for [[RogerEbert.com]] writing that "Williams and Storrie share a chemistry so intense it rivals [[Humphrey Bogart|Bogart]] & [[Lauren Bacall|Bacall]]."<ref name="SlashFilm">{{cite web |url=https://www.slashfilm.com/2043077/canada-heated-rivalry-destroys-worst-trend-american-streaming-tv/ |title=Canada's Heated Rivalry Destroys The Worst Trend Of American Streaming TV |first=B. J. |last=Colangelo |work=[[/Film]] |date=December 5, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="WaPo">{{cite news |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/entertainment/tv/2025/12/06/heated-rivalry-hbo-series-rachel-reid/ |title=What happens when your gay hockey smut becomes a global phenomenon? |work=[[The Washington Post]] |date=December 6, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="Ebert">{{cite web |url=https://www.rogerebert.com/streaming/heated-rivalry-tv-review |title=HBO's "Heated Rivalry" is the Sexiest and Most Significant Queer Show of the Year |website=[[RogerEbert.com]] |date=December 8, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> The series was renewed for a second season in December 2025 with Season 2 expected to release in April 2027.<ref name="THR-interview" />

Williams won Best Leading Performance in a Drama Series at the [[2026 Canadian Screen Awards]] for his performance in ''Heated Rivalry'' on May 31, 2026, becoming the youngest performer to win the award at 25.<ref name="Pique">{{cite web |url=https://www.piquenewsmagazine.com/the-mix/north-of-north-and-40-acres-lead-canadian-screen-awards-nominations-12053564 |title='North of North' and '40 Acres' lead Canadian Screen Awards nominations |first=Alex Nino |last=Gheciu |work=Pique Newsmagazine |location=Toronto |date=March 25, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="CBC-noms">{{cite news |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/entertainment/2026-csa-nominees-9.7140809 |title=North of North, Heated Rivalry, 40 Acres lead Canadian Screen Award nominees |first=Jackson |last=Weaver |work=[[CBC News]] |date=March 25, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="CBC-CSA" />

In December 2025, Williams signed with [[Creative Artists Agency]] for representation.<ref name="CAA">{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2025/12/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-caa-1236651483/ |title='Heated Rivalry's Hudson Williams Signs With CAA |first=Armando |last=Tinoco |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=December 17, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> That same month, he and Storrie starred in ''Ember & Ice'', a three-episode romance fantasy audio series where Williams voiced the character Prince Finn Lunare. The episodes were released on the mobile audio platform Quinn between December 30, 2025 to January 5, 2026.<ref name="Variety-Quinn">{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/connor-storrie-hudson-williams-erotic-romantasy-quinn-heated-rivalry-1236618044/ |title='Heated Rivalry' Stars Connor Storrie and Hudson Williams to Narrate Erotic Romantasy Series for Quinn |first=Emily |last=Longeretta |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=December 29, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="Cosmo">{{cite web |url=https://www.cosmopolitan.com/entertainment/celebs/a69876010/hudson-williams-connor-storrie-quinn-ember-and-ice/ |title=Exclusive: Hudson Williams & Connor Storrie Are Rival Fae Princes in Quinn's New Romantasy Audio, 'Ember & Ice' |work=[[Cosmopolitan (magazine)|Cosmopolitan]] |date=December 29, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>

On February 28, 2026, Williams had a cameo in a ''[[Saturday Night Live]]'' episode hosted by Storrie.<ref name="CNN-SNL">{{cite news |url=https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/28/entertainment/connor-storrie-snl-hockey-accents |title=Connor Storrie survives his big 'SNL' test |first1=Dan |last1=Heching |first2=Alli |last2=Rosenbloom |work=[[CNN]] |date=February 28, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> He has starred in two music videos: as Count Orlok in Love Lucille's "Lights On" and then as the featured heartthrob character in [[Laufey (singer)|Laufey]]'s [[Madwoman (song)|Madwoman]] video, alongside other prominent mixed Asian stars [[Alysa Liu]], [[Lola Tung]], and [[Megan Skiendiel]].<ref name="GayTimes">{{cite web |url=https://www.gaytimes.com/music/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-channels-nosferatu-music-video/ |title=Heated Rivalry's Hudson Williams channels Nosferatu in horror music video |first=Sam |last=Damshenas |work=[[Gay Times]] |date=January 7, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="THR-Madwoman">{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/laufey-madwoman-music-video-hudson-williams-1236562507/ |title=How Laufey's Star-Studded "Madwoman" Music Video Came to Life With Hudson Williams, Lola Tung |first=Nicole |last=Fell |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=April 13, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>

=== Upcoming projects ===
In February 2026, Williams was cast as Henry Park in ''[[Yaga (TV series)|Yaga]]'', a Crave mystery thriller series based on the play by [[Kat Sandler]], starring alongside [[Carrie-Anne Moss]], [[Noah Reid]] and [[Clark Backo]].<ref name="Yaga">{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2026/02/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-crave-yaga-drama-series-1236728206/ |title='Heated Rivalry' Star Hudson Williams Re-teams With Crave For Baba Yaga Drama |first=Max |last=Goldbart |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=February 18, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> In April 2026, [[AMC+]] acquired the exclusive United States streaming rights to the series and it is scheduled to premiere later in 2026.<ref name="Deadline-AMC">{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2026/04/hudson-williams-heated-rivalry-yaga-followup-series-crave-1236873748/ |title=Hudson Williams' 'Heated Rivalry' Followup 'Yaga' Heads To AMC+ |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=April 30, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>

In March 2026, Netflix announced that Williams would appear in a recurring role as Duncan Rheingans-Yoo in ''The Altruists'', a limited series about the collapse of the cryptocurrency exchange [[FTX]], starring [[Julia Garner]] and [[Anthony Boyle]].<ref name="Altruists">{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2026/03/hudson-williams-jennifer-grey-cast-the-altruists-1236757124/ |title=Heated Rivalry's Hudson Williams & Jennifer Grey Among 6 Cast In Netflix's Sam Bankman-Fried Limited Series |first=Rosy |last=Cordero |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=March 17, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="Variety-Altruists">{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-netflix-ftx-the-altruists-1236691389/ |title='Heated Rivalry' Star Hudson Williams Among Six to Recur in Netflix FTX Series 'The Altruists' |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=March 17, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> That same month, he was cast in a leading role opposite [[Dylan O'Brien]] in the feature film ''Apparatus'', directed by [[Sofia Banzhaf]],<ref name="Apparatus">{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2026/03/hudson-williams-dylan-obrien-to-star-apparatus-thriller-1236768004/ |title=Dylan O'Brien & Hudson Williams Set For Sofia Banzhaf Thriller 'Apparatus' |first=Matt |last=Grobar |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=March 27, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> and in April 2026 he joined an ensemble cast including [[Charlize Theron]], [[Julia Garner]], and [[Demi Moore]] in the culinary thriller film ''[[Tyrant (film)|Tyrant]]'', directed by [[David Weil (filmmaker)|David Weil]].<ref name="Tyrant">{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2026/04/hudson-williams-paapa-essiedu-join-tyrant-thriller-1236870972/ |title=Paapa Essiedu, Hudson Williams, Omar Apollo & Nara Smith Join Amazon MGM Thriller 'Tyrant' |first=Matt |last=Grobar |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=April 27, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>

Alongside acting, Williams continues to write and direct.  In a January 2026 interview Williams shared his aspiration to make his feature film directorial debut based on his own script in the next five years.<ref name="ShutUpEvan1" /><ref name="USAToday" />

== Influences ==
Williams has named [[Heath Ledger]] as his all-time favourite actor and has also mentioned [[Michelle Williams]], [[Mark Rylance]], [[Marlon Brando]] and [[Parker Posey]] among the performers who have influenced him.  Among filmmakers, he has cited [[Alfred Hitchcock]], [[Billy Wilder]], [[Ingmar Bergman]] and [[Stanley Kubrick]] as favourites.<ref name="ShutUpEvan2">{{cite AV media |people=Katz, Evan Ross (host); Williams, Hudson (guest) |date=January 2026 |title=Hudson Williams Part 2 (Full Episode) |series=Shut Up Evan |medium=Podcast |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CRS-n5rDRZI |time=13:41 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> He has spoken of his longtime love of queer cinema, naming ''[[Moonlight (2016 film)|Moonlight]]'' and ''[[Brokeback Mountain]]'' among his favourite films, and has cited [[Rooney Mara]] in ''[[Carol (film)|Carol]]'' and [[Trevante Rhodes]] in ''Moonlight'' as inspirations for his portrayal of Shane Hollander.<ref name="GQ-Hype" /><ref name="Langara-TikTok">{{cite web |url=https://www.tiktok.com/@langaracollege/video/7580806531747220792 |title=Fan Questions for Hudson Williams |website=Langara College TikTok |date=December 6, 2025 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>

== Public image and brand partnerships ==
Following the release of ''Heated Rivalry'', Williams experienced a rapid rise to fame. At the [[Golden Globe Awards]] in January 2026, he announced a donation to [[BC Children's Hospital]].<ref name="VanSun" /> On January 16, 2026, he made his runway debut opening [[Dsquared²]]'s show at [[Milan Fashion Week]],<ref name="GQ-Milan">{{cite magazine |url=https://www.gq.com/story/hudson-williams-heated-rivalry-runway-debut-milan-dsquared2 |title=Hudson Williams Just Made His Milan Fashion Week Debut |first=Savannah |last=Sobrevilla |magazine=[[GQ]] |date=January 16, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> and on January 25, 2026, he and Storrie participated in the [[2026 Winter Olympics torch relay]] in [[Feltre]], Italy.<ref name="Variety-torch">{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2026/sports/columns/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-connor-storrie-olympic-torch-1236640468/ |title=Heated Rivalry Stars Hudson Williams and Connor Storrie Carry Olympic Torch in Italy |first=Mark |last=Malkin |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=January 25, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> That same month, Williams met [[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian prime minister]] [[Mark Carney]] at an event promoting the Canadian film and television industry in [[Ottawa]].<ref name="CBC-PM">{{cite news |url=https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/livestory/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-prime-minister-mark-carney-ottawa-9.7067322 |title=Prime minister meets Heated Rivalry stars, pays tribute to hit show 'that could only be made in Canada' |first=Sarah |last=Petz |work=[[CBC News]] |location=Ottawa |date=January 29, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> He attended the [[98th Academy Awards]] and the [[Vanity Fair (magazine)|Vanity Fair]] Oscars after-party in March 2026, where his appearances generated a combined media impact value of $6.16 million for designer brands [[Balenciaga]] and [[Bulgari]].<ref name="THR-Oscars">{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/style/who-won-oscars-red-carpet-which-brand-should-thank-zendaya-1236541032/ |title=Chanel Tops the Oscars Red Carpet Power Rankings |first=Laurie |last=Brookins |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=March 19, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>
[[File:Guests at the 2026 Met Gala 297.jpg|thumb|Williams at the 2026 [[Met Gala]]]]

Williams was named a "Friend of the House" for fashion brand, [[Balenciaga]], in February 2026, appearing in the brand's "Heart and Body" campaign and attending its fashion week shows.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rikhy |first=Trishna |date=2026-02-17 |title=Hudson Williams Wants You to ‘Stay Sexy’ |url=https://www.gq.com/story/hudson-williams-balenciaga-spring-2026-campaign-exclusive-interview |access-date=2026-07-25 |website=GQ |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>https://www.balenciaga.com/en-us/summer-26-campaign</ref> In April 2026, he became the first non-athlete to star in a campaign for [[Peloton Interactive]].<ref name="People-Peloton2">{{cite web |url=https://people.com/hudson-williams-flashes-his-abs-in-new-peloton-ad-exclusive-11948522 |title=Hudson Williams Flashes Abs in New Peloton Ad |first=Stacy |last=Lambe |work=[[People (magazine)|People]] |date=April 14, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="Peloton-PR2">{{cite press release |url=https://investor.onepeloton.com/news-releases/news-release-details/peloton-taps-hudson-williams-new-creative-campaign-reclaim-joy |title=Peloton Taps Hudson Williams For New Creative Campaign |publisher=[[Peloton Interactive]] |date=April 14, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>  Williams' Peloton campaign video drew massive engagement, amassing over 5 million views on YouTube within the first six days of its release.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Donaldson |first=Ali |date=April 20, 2026 |title=Peloton Released Its Most-Watched Video Since the Pandemic—Thanks to This Buzzy Casting |url=https://www.inc.com/ali-donaldson/peloton-released-its-most-watched-video-since-the-pandemic-thanks-to-this-buzzy-casting/91333204 |website=Inc.com}}</ref>  Williams attended his first [[Met Gala]] in May 2026 as a guest at the [[Instagram]] table in a custom [[Bullfighter|matador]]-inspired look designed by [[Balenciaga]] creative director [[Pierpaolo Piccioli]] and eye makeup inspired by one of his favorite films - [[Black Swan (film)|Black Swan]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Allaire |first=Christian |date=2026-05-04 |title=Hudson Williams Turns Into a (Shirtless) Balenciaga Matador at the 2026 Met Gala |url=https://www.vogue.com/article/2026-met-gala-hudson-williams-red-carpet-fashion |access-date=2026-07-25 |website=Vogue |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Patterson |first=Kenneal |date=2026-05-05 |title=Hudson Williams Makes His Met Gala 2026 Debut In Black Swan-Inspired Makeup |url=https://www.vanityfair.com/style/story/hudson-williams-makes-his-met-gala-2026-debut-in-black-swan-inspired-makeup |access-date=2026-07-25 |website=Vanity Fair |language=en-US}}</ref>  That same month, Williams was also named a "Friend of the House" for jewelry brand [[Bulgari]] and appeared in the brand's "Gold & Steel" campaign.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kostic |first=Jana |date=2026-05-26 |title=Hudson Williams Stars in Bulgari Gold & Steel Campaign |url=https://www.designscene.net/2026/05/hudson-williams-bulgari-gold-steel.html |access-date=2026-07-25 |website=DSCENE |language=en-US}}</ref> Williams' skincare routine and recommended products have drawn widespread interest.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lee |first=Carol |date=2025-12-16 |title=The Beauty Products Heated Rivalry Star Hudson Williams Uses to the Last Drop |url=https://www.thecut.com/article/hudson-williams-skin-care-routine-best-beauty-products.html |access-date=2026-07-25 |website=The Cut |language=en}}</ref>

Williams has spoken publicly about the challenges of navigating his sudden rise to global fame, including privacy intrusions from paparazzi and unsolicited photography.<ref name="Variety-fame">{{cite web |url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-dark-side-fame-1236635987/ |title='Heated Rivalry' Star Hudson Williams Details Struggles of Sudden Fame |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |date=January 20, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref><ref name="ShutUpEvan1" /> In March 2026, Williams and ''Heated Rivalry'' co-star [[François Arnaud (actor)|François Arnaud]] issued a joint statement condemning bigoted and [[Parasocial interaction|parasocial]] behaviour among portions of the show's fanbase.<ref name="RS">{{cite web |url=https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/heated-rivalry-hudson-williams-francois-arnaud-online-hate-1235527646/ |title='Heated Rivalry' Stars Tell Fans to 'GTFOH' If They Can't Be Kind on Social Media |work=[[Rolling Stone]] Australia |date=March 10, 2026 |access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref>

extract: Hudson Williams (born February 13, 2001) is a Canadian actor. He rose to prominence for his breakout role as Shane Hollander in the Crave original television series Heated Rivalry (2025–present), for which he won the Canadian Screen Award for Best Leading Performance in a Drama Series. He will appear in the upcoming Crave series Yaga, the Netflix limited series The Altruists, and the films Apparatus and Tyrant.
